name: semrush
description: Competitive SEO and traffic data from the Semrush MCP server: keyword search volume and difficulty, the keywords and pages a domain ranks for, organic competitors and keyword gaps, backlink profiles, traffic estimates and audience breakdowns, plus project-backed site audits and position tracking. (test)

tessl.name: adobe/semrush
tessl.description: Third-party competitive SEO data via the Semrush MCP server (v2). Answers what a domain ranks for, which pages earn its traffic, who competes with it, where the keyword gaps are, and what its backlink profile looks like — for any site, not only your own. Complements first-party Search Console data.
